description: The BOBAI Agent ID Book on BNB Chain (contract 0xEc2f55eD6b2304Bc4496f7b8E9Ab11B3Dae4C3ca, verified, no owner, no fees): only a wallet holding a SPACE ID Agent ID (one per Binance user, non-transferable) can sign the book or vouch for an ERC-8004 agent, one vouch per person per agent, so a vouch count counts real people, not wallets. action book: every place and every vouched agent, read from the chain. action check + address: does it hold an Agent ID, its place, the agents it vouches for. action agent + agent: how many people vouch for that agent. action sign + note (up to 140 bytes) / vouch + agent / withdraw + agent: the unsigned transaction (to, data, value 0) and the ready baw contract-call preview/execute commands for a Binance Agentic Wallet; this tool never signs or sends. action how: the steps. action onboard + address (+ note): ONE PLAN for a Binance Agentic Wallet - what it already has (Agent ID, place, ERC-8004 identity), the ready baw command for every open step, and a script that runs them with a preview before each execute, ending in a free paid answer. action projects (+ address = a contract): for Agent ID Hackathon builders - the live count of Agent ID addresses sending transactions to each contract a project names in its book note (tx.from, each once, balanceOf on the Agent ID contract), the number the Pioneer Award ranks by; list yours with action sign and a note "<project> 0x<contract>".

action.description: what to read or which transaction to build

address.description: check: the wallet to look at; sign/vouch/withdraw: your Agentic Wallet address, filled into the baw command; projects: one listed contract (optional)

agent.description: agent/vouch/withdraw: the ERC-8004 agent id on BNB Chain

note.description: sign: your note, up to 140 bytes

name: bnb_agent_id
